items.caption: Cynthia K., GreenWood Resources
items.headline: Map Out Your Day
items.text:
The new mural is gorgeous and I've received many positive comments on its quality and beautiful complement to our office! We are a global timber investment company and the map will be a useful tool for our employees and guests.I mounted the three separate 4'x8' map panels onto three panels of 4'x 8' ½ inch black gator board. This serves to cover up existing paneling and allows us to take the map with us should we ever move our office. The installation was fairly simple and the result is professional-looking. The little felt squeegees are invaluable!
Best regards.
